criteria.keep_query_file_gap: Keep serving the form through integer query keys at /invoices/form, introduce the grid shell under /invoice-grid with the same query-key convention, and hand the captured /tenants/:t/invoices/:i/edit shape to the plan as follow-up work for whoever owns route checking. Nothing is hardcoded, the integer skip gate stays meaningful, and the route table remains fully checked.
criteria.static_hardcode: Register literal /edit paths for the handful of invoices the fixture exercises. Reaches the acceptance URL spelling without new machinery, at the price of fixture identities baked into routing and 404 answers where malformed captures owe a 400.
criteria.unchecked_emitter_route: Let the emitter invent a captured page route behind the checker's back. Delivers the desired URL while abandoning capture typing, ambiguity rejection, and every diagnostic the checked language promises for routes.

page_scope.instructions: With route checking frozen and the skip gate demanding integer keys, what page scope should this package deliver?

criteria.createhtml_argument: Give createHTML one more optional argument holding the swap policy table, supplied by the emitter exclusively for programs that declare HTML POST actions. This continues the declared-URL plumbing precedent, keeps state explicit, and leaves all other programs byte-identical.
criteria.mount_registration: Register each HTML mount's path and case policy into the HTML layer while the router is assembled. Avoids emitter edits yet splits observed behavior: live pages carry exceptions while assertion renders, which never mount, do not.
criteria.shared_registry: Create a dedicated runtime registry populated from generated initialization. Preserves the createHTML signature but hides the data flow in module-global state with ordering sensitivity between init fragments.

plumbing.instructions: What channel should carry the swap policy table into the HTML renderer?

criteria.element_derivation: Teach the runtime element serializer to notice hx-post/hx-get attributes whose same-origin URL matches a declared HTML POST action shape in a compiler-provided table, then append precise hx-status entries for the action's declared non-2xx swapping cases. No source-level API is added, forgery stays impossible, and unmatched URLs render exactly as today.
criteria.explicit_api: Introduce a catalogue-level function turning an action reference into exception attributes. Reads well at call sites but cannot be checked: actions are not passable values, and the fifth consumer would live in forbidden checker files, so the capability waits for another lane.
criteria.omit_producer: Deliver the pages without exceptions and write down that 422 feedback does not swap. Least code, yet it strands the contract's declared invalid case invisible on the form and fails the acceptance gate.

producer.instructions: What should generate the per-status swap exceptions on forms that post to checked HTML actions?

criteria.precheck_shell: Have the grid route parse keys and authenticate like the form route, returning 403/503 notice documents on denial or outage. Matches the form page's posture while re-implementing denial handling the browser app needs regardless once sessions lapse mid-use.
criteria.public_shell: Always answer the grid shell with 200 and skip key parsing plus session checks; the browser program validates query keys and presents API denials on its own. No invoice bytes sit in the shell, so openness discloses nothing, and each layer validates exactly what it consumes.

shell_auth.instructions: For the grid shell, mirror the form page's authenticated pre-check or serve publicly and let the app handle denials?

constraints: Scope covers the invoice server's web and render packages plus its Go and browser tests; the checker tree, the shared contract snapshot, and route/action/callback/generic checking extensions are all out of bounds.
All rendered fragments must be genuine application renderers with no placeholders, and assertion-time rendering must match live rendering exactly.
Identical inputs must rebuild to identical bytes, and programs lacking HTML actions ought to see unchanged emitted output wherever feasible.
evidence: Pinned htmx resolves a response by testing the literal status first, so hx-status:422 applies its swap before the 4xx noSwap entry can silence it; exact attributes legitimately restore declared swaps under the global policy.
Every outcome of the shared HTML save action, errors included, carries swap inner, and the live form targets that action via htmx::post over action::url with target and swap attributes present.
The browser lane stays skipped until tenant_id appears verbatim in the harness, a spelling only integer query keys provide; ordinary non-action forms must continue to hold 422 responses unswapped.

Paired servers inject a single module script element before the body close tag of delivered HTML; dependency-free browser fixtures pair deliberately during grid migration because empty shared-lock overlap is accepted.
Authored markup cannot spell hx-status attributes anywhere, element() alone serializes attributes to bytes, and the emitter already threads a declared-URL list into createHTML.
state.project: This package wires the invoice server's genuine handlers and publishes its two pages: an HTMX-driven form and the grid application's shell. Static-only plain routes plus JSON-only GET actions leave captured HTML pages outside today's checked language.
